2026-11-21.title: Why Your SSD Moves Data Behind the Scenes 💾 #Shorts
2026-11-21.description: Inside NAND flash: logical file addresses, write requests, erase cycles, mapping updates and wear distribution. Original 32-second stylized technical visualization by EGI. 2026-11-22.title: How a Heat Pipe Moves Heat Without a Pump 🔥 #Shorts
2026-11-22.description: Watch heat enter an evaporator, liquid vaporize, vapor travel to the condenser, heat leave through the fins and liquid return through the wick by capillary action. Original 32-second stylized scientific visualization by EGI. #HeatPipe #Physics #ThermalEngineering #EGI

2026-11-23.title: Why Car Wheels Spin at Different Speeds in Turns ⚙️ #Shorts
